title: Mazi: a bolder visual direction
question: More ambitious structures, with the same clear Home-to-memory journey. Images will fill in as they render.

options.label: Memory Signal
options.thesis: A photographic time-field: select a dated column and its memory unfolds.
options.viewport: A full-width wall of dated photo slices opens one generous image, with a stable index below.
options.risk: The most experimental option; the data language can feel colder than the memories.
options.case: Warmth comes from unchanged photographs; chrome stays monochrome, and strobing is removed.

options.label: Our Panorama
options.thesis: Giant type and an asymmetric photo panorama turn the archive into an explorable composition.
options.viewport: Oversized lowercase year and season, one dominant photo tile, smaller neighboring moments, visible next-pane control.
options.risk: Large typography must leave enough room for photographs and usable controls.
options.case: Beats the signal field on warmth and immediate recognition; coral translates the colder source accent.

options.label: Return Tickets
options.thesis: A memory index and a dimensional photographic ticket make each return feel like a departure.
options.viewport: A precise archive board sits beside one large folded photographic ticket with Open memory.
options.risk: The travel metaphor must also work for a quiet Sunday at home.
options.case: Holds clarity through a stable dated index, but the travel ritual is narrower.

options.label: An Index of Us
options.thesis: A personal lexicon gives ordinary moments the space and care of treasured specimens.
options.viewport: A narrow shoulder index, two readable text columns, and an oversized hinged photographic plate.
options.risk: Deliberate and literary; less immediately playful.
options.case: Holds personal significance while demanding more reading than the signal field.

options.label: The Memory Garden
options.thesis: A sculptural collection of photo-bearing islands makes shared memories a place to explore.
options.viewport: One dominant sculptural island carries the selected photo; two smaller islands and a stable memory list keep exploration legible.
options.risk: The scene needs careful restraint to feel personal rather than like a game or a geography claim.
options.case: Beats the signal field on warmth and visible exploration; islands mean existing memories, never inferred locations.

options.label: The Atlas of Us
options.thesis: A navigable chart of dated memories brings one photographic moment into focus.
options.viewport: A bounded curved memory chart beside a large selected photograph and an ordinary event index.
options.risk: An astronomy language can overpower a personal archive; every plotted point must represent a real memory.
options.case: Holds spatial exploration; chronology replaces celestial coordinates and no social graph is inferred.

canonCard.label: The familiar photo library
canonCard.thesis: A chronological photo grid with conventional album navigation.
canonCard.viewport: Home navigation, a featured memory, and a clean chronological grid.
canonCard.risk: Efficient, but gives up much of the spatial identity you asked to explore.
